about: The block Linked sessions gives to link a session on claude.ai, and the line it gives for a session on this Mac, for one ticket's answer at two addresses, with the link client's sha256 written @CLIENT_SHA256@; and the fixed sentences the block and the link client print, {host} the ADE's host. The page's case (ui/src/components/CloudLink.test.tsx) checks that the page gives exactly these, and writes this file with CLOUD_LINK_WRITE_VECTORS=1; the client's (tests/test_cloud_link.py) runs each block in a shell and checks that the link client prints the same sentences.
name: Planner

blocks.http://127.0.0.1:8765:
# To the Claude Code session it is pasted into: run this block as it is with the Bash tool, in the background (it waits out the pairing's hold), and tell the person each line it prints that begins with ADE:, word for word.
python3 -I - <<'ADE_CLIENT' &&
import hashlib, os, sys, urllib.error, urllib.request
try:
    import cryptography
except ImportError:
    sys.exit("ADE: This session's python3 cannot import cryptography, which the link client needs, so nothing was fetched, installed or run: install it for that python3 with pip, which Allow package managers lets through, then paste the block again.")
URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/ade/link/client"
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=60) as answer:
        client = answer.read(16 * 1024 * 1024)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    sys.exit(f"ADE: no link client from {URL}: HTTP {e.code}; nothing was installed or run.")
except Exception as e:
    why = getattr(e, "reason", e)
    if str(why).startswith("Tunnel connection failed: 403"):
        sys.exit("ADE: A claude.ai environment whose network refuses 127.0.0.1 needs it allowed: in the environment's settings, under Network access, choose Limited and add 127.0.0.1 to Allowed domains, keeping Allow package managers ticked; a running session follows the change within about a minute.")
    sys.exit(f"ADE: no link client from {URL} ({type(why).__name__}); nothing was installed or run.")
if hashlib.sha256(client).hexdigest() != "@CLIENT_SHA256@":
    sys.exit("ADE: The link client the ADE served is not the one the page carries (its sha256 differs), so nothing was installed or run: take the block again from the page the ADE itself serves, which carries the client of its own release.")
home = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".proofpane-ade")
try:
    os.makedirs(home, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    part = os.path.join(home, f"ade_link.py.{os.getpid()}.part")
    with open(part, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(client)
    os.replace(part, os.path.join(home, "ade_link.py"))
except OSError as e:
    sys.exit(f"ADE: the link client could not be put in {home} ({type(e).__name__}); nothing was run.")
ADE_CLIENT
python3 -I "$HOME/.proofpane-ade/ade_link.py" setup --url http://127.0.0.1:8765 --ticket PP-ABCDEFGH --e2e 0:none --name 'Planner' --kind cloud --ref "https://claude.ai/code/session_${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID#cse_}"
